products.name: Heirloom Black Rice
products.description: Sourced from traditional Korean farms, our black rice is rich in anthocyanins and offers a distinctive nutty flavour with a deep violet hue.

products.name: Five-Grain Blend
products.description: A traditional blend of rice, barley, black bean, millet, and sorghum — crafted for health-conscious consumers seeking whole-grain nutrition.

products.name: Golden Millet
products.description: Naturally gluten-free and packed with magnesium and phosphorus. Our golden millet is stone-milled to preserve its natural nutrients and gentle sweetness.

products.name: Barley Flour
products.description: Cold-milled from premium Korean barley, this flour is ideal for bread, pastries, and traditional Korean cuisine. High in beta-glucan for heart health.

products.name: Sprouted Brown Rice
products.description: Carefully sprouted at controlled temperatures to unlock GABA, enzymes, and vitamins. A superior alternative to white rice for the health-forward consumer.

products.name: Job's Tears (Adlay)
products.description: Used in traditional Korean medicine for centuries, Job's Tears offer a chewy texture and mild flavour, prized for their anti-inflammatory properties.
